figurative_meaning_en: To look favorably or show sympathy
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভগবান দরিদ্রের প্রতি চোখ তুলে চান না।
সে তার বন্ধুর দুঃখে চোখ তুলে চাইল।
example_sentences_in_english: God does not look favorably upon the poor.
She looked with sympathy at her friend's misfortune.
history: This idiom draws from religious folklore where divine gaze represents mercy or neglect towards the underprivileged.
note: Often used in contexts invoking divine intervention or human empathy.
